name: plan-firearms-cannon
about: Test plan through the plan_checks bot: the Hand Cannon, the Flamethrower Rifle and the Full Auto Rifle. Magazines (cannon 6, with a pistol 16, two cannons 12); a lone cannon a round every 600 ms; pistol + cannon either way round a pistol, cannon, pistol burst 100 ms apart with the pistol's 300 ms between bursts; two cannons every 600 ms; right click with a cannon fires both guns at once; an off-hand cannon with a sword 1. The Flamethrower Rifle: 30 rounds and the rifle's burst; the held flamethrower drains 10 mana a second, no rounds, and runs dry. The Full Auto Rifle: 30 rounds, the burst, and held full auto at a round every 100 ms, no mana, its rounds' headings spread wide (the burst's tight). Equipment requirements are turned off, as in plan-firearms-guns.
